_calendarSeriesMap: For Pamplin calendar-feed sources (see calendarid below): if a feed event's title starts with one of these prefixes, the reducer stamps the mapped series so extraction is grounded. A miss falls back to the model + the source's default series — so this is an optional optimization, never load-bearing.

sources._comment: ECE+CS joint colloquium (Alexandria campus). ECE publishes each semester at a NEW year-pinned URL (e.g. fall-2026-colloquium.html); the canonical Colloquium.html goes stale. Update this URL each semester — check ece.vt.edu/news/vt-ece-department-news/ for the current one.

VT Math department calendar. The page (url) is JS-injected by a Pamplin calendar widget and reduces to a masthead only (Playwright fails too — the widget needs jQuery). Instead we read the widget's public JSON feed via `calendarid` (fetchCalendarFeed in calendar-feed.js); `url` stays the human-facing page and remains the source_url/cache key. Feed is Math-only, mixing several series — see calendarSeriesMap above; one-offs fall back to this default `series`. Find a department's calendarid from the registry pamplinstorage.blob.core.windows.net/calendarwidget-v2/calendars.json.
